task: R10 — PnL-aware / utility-aware loss functions for LightGBM and NN

metrics.expected_LOSO_h10_gain_top1: +6 to +15 (S2: custom LightGBM PnL multiclass obj)

top_picks.rank_1: S2 — LightGBM custom multiclass PnL objective: softmax + per-class reward (r_k = (k-1)*Delta_p - 2*fee*1[k!=1]), loss = -E[reward] + entropy reg, closed-form gradient/hessian, CE-warmstart 50 rounds, drop-in iter_002 Scheme C
top_picks.rank_2: S1 — sample_weight = clip(|Delta_p|, q99) in lgb.Dataset (single line), composes with S2

ruled_out: S5 differentiable Sharpe (wrong objective for raw cumulative PnL leaderboard)
S10 continuous bet sizing (platform requires discrete {0,1,2})
S3 cost matrix CE (mathematically same as S2 under our fee structure)
key_findings: Volkova (Jane Street 2024 1st) used weighted MSE NOT custom utility loss — argues for S1 first
Yirun (Jane Street 2021 1st) used utility-as-loss + SAE+MLP — validates S2/S4 in production
HYD (Optiver 2023 1st) used MAE regression — argues for S6 alternative
arxiv 2509.04541 (Khubiyev 2025): MSE Sharpe -0.46 -> MDDLoss Sharpe 1.76 on same LSTM
arxiv 2502.17493 (return-weighted CE): CNN 33.73% -> 61.73% annual return (this is exactly our S1)
Lopez de Prado meta-labeling generalizes our hand-coded threshold gate (T=0.55, delta=0.10)
implementation_priority: Day 1: ship S1 (sample weight) as low-risk improvement
Day 2-3: ship S2 (custom LGBM PnL obj) with CE warm-start + entropy reg
Day 4: stack S8 (isotonic + EV gating) on top
Day 5-7: explore S7 (meta-labeling) as biggest potential lever
notes: Strict adherence to CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS.md: Delta_p used at training time only via cached midprice_diff_h, never seen by Predictor. All schemes are sym-agnostic. No platform contract change. CE warm-start + entropy regularizer are mandatory for S2 to avoid collapse. Hessian uses diagonal Newton approximation, standard for multiclass focal-loss type custom objectives.
